an upcoming event that will have a sudden
continues scaling up or down

qualifiers.scope: Application, Network and Gateway Load Balancers

evidence.quote: Load balancer Capacity Unit (LCU) reservations allow you to reserve a static minimum capacity for your load balancer.

When minimum capacity is configured, your load balancer continues scaling up or down based on the traffic received, but also prevents the capacity from going lower than the minimum capacity configured.
You have an upcoming event that will have a sudden, unusual high traffic and want to ensure your load balancer can support the sudden traffic spike during the event.
Load balancer Capacity Unit (LCU) reservations allow you to reserve a static minimum capacity for your load balancer.
